1.Author: George Orwell
1.Description: A dystopian novel set in a world where the government controls every aspect of people's lives. Winston Smith begins to question the system and secretly rebels against the oppressive regime. A powerful story about freedom, truth, surveillance, and the dangers of totalitarianism.

2.Author: Arthur Conan Doyle
2.Description: A mysterious detective story about the brilliant Sherlock Holmes and his loyal friend Dr. Watson. Together, they investigate the strange legend of a terrifying supernatural hound that haunts an ancient English family. Using logic and observation, Holmes must uncover the truth behind the mysterious events.
2.Name: The Hound of the Baskervilles
